title: ophiorrhiza microphylla
intro: Ophiorrhiza microphylla, commonly known as the small-leaved snake root, is a type of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophiorrhiza microphylla include reducing fever, relieving digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
